app.tunnels.err-port: Enter a valid port (leave blank to auto-assign, or 1-65535)
app.tunnels.confirm-stop-body: The corresponding forwarding port will close immediately.
app.tunnels.empty-none: No tunnels are running (fill in the parameters and click Start)
app.tunnels.err-list-failed: Failed to read the tunnel list
app.tunnels.bind-hint: Loopback addresses only. Binding to 0.0.0.0 lets any machine on the network reach the intranet through it
app.tunnels.api-create-desc: Create a port-forward tunnel; all three types are supported.
app.tunnels.api-create-hostid: hostId defaults to this app's workspace;
app.tunnels.api-create-local: local forwards bind:port on this machine to the remote target;
app.tunnels.api-create-remote: remote listens on bind:port remotely and forwards back to a local target;
app.tunnels.api-create-dynamic: dynamic opens a SOCKS5 proxy on bind:port (no target needed).
app.tunnels.api-create-port-zero: **port 0 means the system assigns a free port** (listen in the response is the one actually obtained).
app.tunnels.api-create-return: Returns { id, hostId, hostName, type, listen, target?, proxy?, startedAt },
app.tunnels.api-create-proxy: local/dynamic also carry proxy (socks5://host:port, ready to hand to a browser).
app.tunnels.api-create-ready: A return value means the listener is ready; there is no need to check that it is alive.
app.tunnels.api-create-errors: Invalid arguments raise invalid_args; port conflicts, auth failures and unreachable hosts raise handler.
app.tunnels.api-stop-idempotent: Idempotent: stopping the same tunnel twice is not an error (an unknown id also returns { ok: true }).
app.tunnels.api-list-direct: Reads the server registry directly, with no local reconciliation.
app.tunnels.api-info-desc: Reports this app's workspace, the number of running tunnels, and the three supported types. Takes no arguments.
app.tunnels.api-info-usage: Use it to check support before creating a tunnel.
app.tunnels.api-list-desc: List the tunnels that are currently running.
app.tunnels.api-list-return: Returns { tunnels: [...] }, each entry shaped like create's response.
